blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can ask questions in English! To ask questions in the Present Simple, English uses two small words: Do and Does.

We use Do for I, you, we, and they. For example: "Do you work at Czarnikow?" We use Does for he, she, and it. For example: "Does Sophie speak Portuguese?" These two words help you ask hundreds of useful questions at work.

Today you learn five important words: question, answer, know, work, and speak. We go step by step. It is simple, and you can do it!

items.q: Which two words do we use to ask questions in the Present Simple?
items.why: "English uses two small words: Do and Does."

items.q: When do we use "Does"?
items.why: "We use Does for he, she, and it."

items.q: How many new words does the lesson teach today?
items.why: "Today you learn five important words: question, answer, know, work, and speak."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: You can do it step by step.
Asking questions in English is too hard to learn.
Asking questions in English is possible for you.
Do and Does are useful at work.
items.why: Inferência: o texto é positivo — "English comes in CAN's" e "you can do it". O autor discorda que seja difícil demais.

items.q: The sentence "you can do it!" suggests that the author wants you to feel…
items.why: Inferência: o tom é de encorajamento, para o aluno se sentir confiante.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie na entrevista de onboarding do RH. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello! Welcome to Czarnikow. My name is Sophie, and I work in HR. Today I ask you some simple questions. Please answer with "Yes, I do" or "No, I don't." It is easy.

First question: Do you work in London? And do you like your team? I want to know a little about you.

Do you speak Portuguese? Do you speak English every day at work? Many people here speak two languages, and that is good.

Now, do you know Tom? He works in the office next to me. And do you know Anna? She is my manager.

One more question: Do you have questions for me? Please ask. I am happy to answer. Remember, there are no bad questions. We are a team, and I am here to help you. Thank you, and welcome again!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where does Sophie work?
items.why: "My name is Sophie, and I work in HR."

items.q: How does Sophie want you to answer her questions?
options: With "Yes, I do" or "No, I don't"
items.why: "Please answer with 'Yes, I do' or 'No, I don't.'"

items.q: Who is Anna?
items.why: "And do you know Anna? She is my manager."

items.q: Sophie says "there are no bad questions." This suggests that she wants you to feel…
items.why: Inferência: ela quer que você se sinta à vontade para perguntar.

items.q: From the way Sophie speaks, we can guess that she is…
items.why: Inferência: ela dá boas-vindas, diz "I am here to help you" — é amigável.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I have a question for you." A question is…
items.why: Question = pergunta: algo que você pergunta.

items.q: "Yes, that is the right answer." An answer is…
items.why: Answer = resposta: o que você diz a uma pergunta.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Do you ___ Tom? He works with us."
items.why: Know = conhecer/saber. "Do you know Tom?"

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I ___ at Czarnikow from Monday to Friday."
items.why: Work = trabalhar. "I work at Czarnikow."

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Does Sophie ___ Portuguese and English?"
items.why: Speak = falar (uma língua). "Does Sophie speak Portuguese?"

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Nice to meet you! Let's get to know each other." To get to know someone means to…
items.why: Get to know = passar a conhecer alguém.

items.q: "Can I ask you a question?" This means…
options: I want to ask you something
items.why: Ask a question = fazer uma pergunta.

items.q: "Please fill out this form for HR." To fill out means to…
items.why: Fill out = preencher (um formulário).

items.q: "Do you work with Tom?" To work with someone means to…
options: do your job together with them
items.why: Work with = trabalhar junto com alguém.

items.q: "Sophie, can you help me out?" To help someone out means to…
items.why: Help someone out = dar uma ajuda a alguém.
